title.en: An Act Extending the Franchise of the Cebu Telephone and Telegraph Company to Include the Province of Cebu

text.en:
Authority is hereby granted to the Cebu Telephone and Telegraph Company, now operating in
the municipality and Province of Cebu, to extend its lines of communication throughout the Province of Cebu,
and lay, maintain, and operate cables in adjacent waters for the purpose of connecting with telephone systems
on surrounding islands, under the same conditions stipulated in its present franchise, for a period of fifty years
from the date this Act is approved.

All local and long distance measured rates shall be subject to the approval of the Public Utility
Commission.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1924.
